{
  "summary": "The medium-priority alarm 'FIT-101 signal frozen (flatline)' is active because tag FIT-101 has remained unchanged for 30 minutes at a value of 58.3 m3/h. The root cause is likely an analyser left in hold or calibration mode after maintenance, a transmitter failure with last-value hold configured, a communication fault, or a blocked sample line.",
  "likely_causes": [
    "Analyser left in hold or calibration mode after maintenance.",
    "Transmitter failure with last-value hold configured.",
    "Communication fault: a remote I/O module, a gateway, or a fieldbus segment not updating.",
    "Sample line blocked for a sampling analyser."
  ],
  "checks": [
    "Check the local display of the instrument and compare it with the HMI value.",
    "Check the analyser status (hold, calibration, fault) and the maintenance log for recent work.",
    "Check the communication diagnostics for the I/O module or gateway serving the tag.",
    "Cross-check the process with a related measurement or a grab sample."
  ],
  "handover": "FIT-101 signal has been flatlining at 58.3 m3/h since 10:29. Verify the local display, analyser status, and communication diagnostics per SOP-08.",
  "citations": [
    "SOP-08 8.3",
    "SOP-08 8.2",
    "SOP-08 8.4",
    "SOP-08 8.5"
  ]
}
